plugins.description: Mod: a progress bar above the prompt that fills as Claude's tasks and subagents finish, and an Agents pane of animated pixel crabs with cost, tokens and time.

plugins.name: game-studio
plugins.description: Skill: run any Unity game project as a small studio. The lead spawns VFX Artist, 3D Model Artist and Game Programmer workers on its own model and effort, working in parallel and taking turns on the one Unity Editor.
